results.title: Ibrahim Mahama inducted into ECOWAS Business Council, pledges regional cooperation
results.content: Ghanaian businessman and Chief Executive Officer of Engineers & Planners, Ibrahim Mahama, has secured a place on a 15-member ECOWAS Business Council, where he is expected to contribute to efforts to deepen economic cooperation and expand private sector participation across West Africa.

results.title: Four schools book places in 2026 national public speaking grand finale
results.content: The race for the 2026 National Public Speaking Championship has reached its decisive stage, with four schools securing places in the grand finale scheduled for December 3, 2026, at the GNAT Hall in Accra.

results.title: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani undergoes surgery after a soccer injury
results.content: The mayor of America’s largest city got benched on Friday.

results.title: Here are the activities planned for the 42nd National Farmers’ Day in Sunyani
results.content: The Bono Region is preparing to host the 42nd National Farmers’ Day celebration, with Sunyani set to welcome farmers, fishers, researchers and other stakeholders for a seven-day programme highlighting developments and opportunities in agriculture.

results.title: Wa East records 53 development projects, achieves 99.99% revenue target
results.content: The Wa East District Chief Executive (DCE), Adamu Sayibu, has reported significant progress in the district’s development agenda, with 53 projects initiated since June 2025, 35 of which have been completed, while the rest are at various stages of implementation.

results.content: Civil society organisations (CSOs) have rejected the proposed extension of Ghana’s presidential and parliamentary terms from four to five years, while demanding changes to government proposals on the election of Metropolitan, Municipal and District Chief Executives (MMDCEs). results.title: RON Foundation invests in digital education at Atwima Koforidua with modern ICT lab commissioning
results.content: A philanthropic organization, RON Foundation, has cut the sod for the construction of a modern Information and Communication Technology (ICT) laboratory at Atwima Koforidua in the Ashanti Region to boost digital and Artificial Intelligence (AI) education among pupils in the area.

results.title: Galamsey, erratic weather cause unprecedented decline in Ghana’s cocoa production – Kuapa Kokoo MD
results.content: Concerns over the future of Ghana's cocoa industry are growing, as farmers warn that the destruction of forest reserves, illegal mining and changing climate patterns could further undermine cocoa production.

results.title: The Multimedia Group CEO Kwasi Twum honoured at UPSA FAF Eminent Achievement Awards
results.content: Founder of the Multimedia Group, Kwasi Twum, has been honoured at the 2026 edition of the Faculty of Accounting and Finance (FAF) Eminent Achievement Awards at the University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA).

results.title: December 4 declared public holiday for Farmers’ Day
results.content: The government has formally designated Friday, December 4, 2026, as a statutory public holiday to commemorate this year’s National Farmers’ Day celebration.

results.title: EOCO announces fact-finding mission with INTERPOL to QNET’s head office in Malaysia to combat ‘Model Q’ scams and human trafficking
results.content: The Economic and Organised Crime Office in Ghana, has proactively conducted a fact-finding mission to the head office of QNET in Malaysia. QNET officials in Malaysia received the mission. QNET, an international lifestyle and wellness e-commerce and direct-selling leader, is taking firm steps to correct widespread misconceptions and combat the criminal misuse of its corporate name.

results.title: Reinna releases new single, ‘Turn My Back’
results.content: Ghanaian emerging artiste Reinna has released her latest single, ‘Turn My Back’, a song inspired by resilience and the determination to overcome life’s challenges

results.title: Stonebwoy releases ‘Marry You’ ahead of ‘TORCHER III’ album
results.content: Ghanaian musician Stonebwoy has released his latest single, “Marry You”, the first official offering from his forthcoming album, TORCHER III: Flames of Love

results.title: Don’t be in a hurry for titles; prioritise hard work and integrity – Nana Appiah Dankawoso II advises youth
results.content: Chairman of the second edition of the FAF Eminent Achievement Awards, Nana Appiah Dankawoso II, has urged young people to prioritise learning, hard work and integrity over the pursuit of titles and wealth.

results.content: The Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ) has dismissed a complaint alleging conflict of interest, corruption and abuse of power against President John Dramani Mahama, Vice President Prof Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang and businessman Ibrahim Mahama.

results.title: Haruna Iddrisu accuses NPP of abandoning principles for political convenience over early BECE ban
results.content: The Minister for Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has accused the New Patriotic Party (NPP) of abandoning its education policy principles for political convenience over the government's decision to restrict early registration for the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE).

results.title: Xavier-Sosu commends private sector, urges businesses to create more jobs
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Madina, Francis-Xavier Sosu, has commended private sector businesses for their contributions to national development, urging them to expand their operations to create more employment opportunities for Ghanaians.

results.title: Ghana’s FLEGT success opens new doors for Timber Trade and Investment – Lands Minister
results.content: Ghana’s successful introduction of FLEGT licensing is strengthening its position in the international timber market, with the country recording more than 103,000 licences covering over 48,000 cubic metres of wood products destined for 19 European Union member states.

results.title: Central bank cannot engage in private sector lending – BoG Research Director
results.content: The Bank of Ghana (BoG) has underscored the responsibility of commercial banks to provide financing to private businesses, particularly women-led enterprises, saying its mandate is to create a sound and resilient banking system capable of supporting private sector lending.

results.title: Krofuom market to be completed in 2027 as KMA hands over to new contractor
results.content: The Kumasi metropolitan assembly has set new timelines for the completion of the Krofuom market after handing over the abandoned project site to a new contractor.

results.title: GHEL, EPA turn to hydraulic dredging to tackle galamsey damage
results.content: Ghana Heavy Equipment Limited (GHEL) and the Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) are exploring the use of hydraulic dredging technology to remove accumulated sediments from polluted rivers and reclaim lands devastated by illegal mining.

results.title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend’s murder
results.content: A former Kenyan governor has been jailed for 25 years for the murder of a university student who was seven months pregnant with his child.

results.title: Financial system must work effectively and beneficially for women – BoG Director of Research
results.content: The Director of the Research Department at the Bank of Ghana (BoG), Philip Abradu-Otoo, has called for a financial system that delivers meaningful benefits to women, particularly women-led businesses, stressing that access to bank accounts and mobile money services must translate into affordable financing and opportunities for business growth.

results.title: GRIDCo restores power to parts of Ashanti and Western regions after chainsaw operators damage transmission line
results.content: The Ghana Grid Company (GRIDCo) has successfully restored the damaged 330kV Aboadze–Anwomaso transmission line, which tripped and caused power outages in parts of the Ashanti and Western Regions after illegal chainsaw operators felled a tree onto it.

results.title: Zelensky criticises ‘strange’ Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
results.content: Volodymyr Zelensky has voiced deep frustration with the US, criticising Donald Trump for calling Vladimir Putin "my friend" and saying delays in delivering vital anti-ballistic missiles were costing Ukrainian lives.
